title: Diagonal Sum
statement:
Add up the main diagonal of a square grid of whole numbers. The main diagonal runs from the top left corner to the bottom right corner: the first number of the first row, the second number of the second row, and so on.

The first line holds one integer `n`, at least 1. Then come `n` lines, each with `n` integers separated by spaces. The numbers can be zero or negative.

Print the sum of the numbers on the main diagonal. The numbers off the diagonal do not count.

Input:

```text
3
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9
```

Expected output:

```text
15
```
hints: A cell is on the main diagonal when its row index and its column index are the same.
You do not need two nested loops. A grid with `n` rows has exactly `n` cells on its main diagonal.
